title: Natter e-commerce scraper output
description: Structural contract. Completeness, source accuracy, identity uniqueness, exact money, and cross-record totals require application tests.

total.description: Sum of retained result prices in source-currency units, calculated using checked integer cents.

price.description: Verified price for this product/configuration in source-currency units, not integer cents or a string.

colors.description: Include only when at least two distinct selectable colors exist.
